svg.text: - Fixed schema: tables, rows, foreign keys
- Instances to size, patch window, backups
- Access by key (partition / sort key), no JOIN
orders(id PK, user_id FK, total, date)
FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id=u.id;
Use for: orders, payments, accounts, ERP, reporting
Use for: sessions, cart, leaderboards, IoT, catalog
Stateful apps often combine both (polyglot persistence): RDS for transactional data, DynamoDB for high-volume key-based state.
